label: Native libraries (not bundled in this build)
note: No native DLLs are bundled in this build. The entries below are development artifacts only, kept out of the installer until P1 packaging and lawyer sign-off.

packages.name: libmpv
packages.note: Development artifact in src-tauri/lib, not in this installer. LGPL-mode dev build, mpv v0.42.0-11-g8bc468896e. Licensing notice: licenses/native/mpv-Copyright-8bc468896e.txt.

packages.name: FFmpeg (statically linked into the LGPL libmpv build)
packages.note: Development artifact, not in this installer. The zhongfly release names ffmpeg-lgpl-x86_64-git-cc583787b.7z, which points at FFmpeg short ref cc583787b. That ref resolves on FFmpeg GitHub, but filename evidence alone does not prove the exact commit inside libmpv-2.dll. Exact commit is an open P1 verification. See licenses/native/README.md.

packages.name: libmpv-wrapper
packages.note: Development artifact in src-tauri/lib, not in this installer. C bridge between tauri-plugin-libmpv and libmpv. License text is the pinned wrapper LICENSE, copied byte for byte.
